plugins.name: plugin-security-scan
plugins.description: Scans internally-built Claude/Cowork plugins for security flaws: SAST, vulnerable/risky third-party libraries (OSSF Scorecard), sensitive data or secrets leakage (TruffleHog-verified), prompt-injection/instruction-safety risks, and build-time context leakage. Logs every scan to a shared Google Drive record with history and trends.
